levels.surface: يزيد بن عبد الله بن قسيط
محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن ثوبان

notes: Abu Salama and al-Harith are the two who asked Fatima («أنهما سألا فاطمة»): they are links as askers (rule 5), and Fatima, who speaks in the saying, is the last link.
The «الوكيل» in the story and the Prophet's words inside her account are in the scene, not links.
Bukhari-Nasa'i-style archive flags and the K6, HKG and RWY lists disagree on the early links; the text is followed.
